title: Bea's Healthy Habits Treasure Trail | Interactive Story for Kids
description:
Buzz with Bea through five richly illustrated destinations to practise handwashing motions, toothbrushing circles, colourful food spotting, safe movement, and a calm bedtime breath. Every stop includes a real thinking or movement pause and a magical Habit Badge.

An original Tiny Tales story supporting everyday routines, body care, observation, movement, and trusted-grown-up guidance for children ages 3 to 7.
